description: project-brain awareness: inject brain status at session start (incl. after compaction; a launch-time snapshot) and after source edits, throttled reminders to update wiki/graph/diary. Edits inside .brain/wiki/ take a silent auto-snapshot of the wiki ledger (.brain/state/wiki.git). Read-only toward MemPalace; silent no-op without .brain/; opt out with PROJECT_BRAIN_HOOKS_DISABLED=1.
